obligations.summary: Submit to the Commission the Replacement Ratio, Credit Hour Production Ratio, Viability Index, three-year graduate averages, a 250-word Program Overview, and a 500-word Rationale to Continue.
obligations.verbatim_quote: Institutions must provide to the Commission the Replacement Ratio for all degree programs, the Credit Hour Production Ratio for undergraduate programs only, the Viability Index for undergraduate programs, three-year average graduate counts for under-threshold programs, a Program Overview limited to 250 words, and a Rationale to Continue limited to 500 words.
obligations.unit_rationale: The required submissions are ratio and index metrics computed from institutional data.

obligations.summary: Implement any approved program suspensions or mergers before academic year 2026-2027.
obligations.verbatim_quote: Any approved suspensions or mergers must be implemented before academic year 2026-2027.
obligations.unit_rationale: Program suspension and merger execution is an academic affairs responsibility.

obligations.summary: Respond to the Commission's preliminary under-threshold program list within 30 days of receipt.
obligations.verbatim_quote: In mid-to-late July the Commission will provide institutions a preliminary list of under-threshold programs.
obligations.unit_rationale: Institutional response to the preliminary list would be coordinated by academic affairs.

response.extraction_notes: The guidance describes a Commission action in mid-to-late July; whether it creates a responsive institutional deadline is not stated.
